description.value: Mushrooms sprout from the ground and pour spores into the air in a 20-foot radius centred on a point within range. Creatures in the area must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they are befuddled by psychedelic spores for 1 minute. While befuddled, a creature must make a Wisdom saving throw the first time it makes an attack, or targets a creature with a spell each turn. On a failure, you can choose a different creature in range to become a target.\n\nA creature that is immune to the poisoned or charmed conditions automatically succeeds on their saving throw.
